create_byte_text_encoder: create a ByteTextEncoder that encodes text into byte-level integer IDs with optional additional tokens
create_token_text_encoder: create a TokenTextEncoder backed by a vocabulary list with OOV hash buckets and configurable tokenization
encode_text_byte_encoder: encode text into a list of integer IDs using ByteTextEncoder with ID 0 reserved for padding
decode_ids_byte_encoder: decode a list of integer IDs back into text using ByteTextEncoder dropping padding IDs
save_load_token_encoder: save a TokenTextEncoder to file and load it back with vocabulary, OOV settings, and tokenizer config
